product.title: Changing of the Guard, Big Ben, Thames & Tower of London Tour

description.text: See the iconic royal sights of London on a full-day tour that showcases the best of the capital—a combination of two popular sightseeing experiences. Witness the Changing of the Guard ceremony outside Buckingham Palace, cruise along the Thames River to central London, an then meet an iconic Beefeater during a visit to the Tower of London. Stops include Buckingham Palace, Thames River, Tower of London. Local commentary and route logistics are handled so you can focus on royal landmarks, river views, and neighborhood walking or cycling highlights. Ideal for visitors basing in London who want a guided city experience without coordinating Tube routes, attraction tickets, or landmark timing on their own.
